body: # S&P 500 Monthly Review: Index Sets New Record at 7,580, Notching Ninth Consecutive Weekly Gain on AI Rally and Iran Optimism. The S&P 500 closed at a new all-time high of 7,580.06 on Friday 29 May 2026, advancing 0.22% on the final trading day of May and completing its ninth consecutive weekly gain — the longest winning streak for the benchmark since 2023. The record close capped a month in which the S&P 500 advanced approximately 5%, building on April's gains and extending one of the most powerful sustained rallies in the index's modern history. The catalyst for the session's advance was a combination of strong corporate earnings — headlined by Dell Technologies' extraordinary post-market surge of nearly 40% on rosy AI-driven data centre demand — and late-session optimism following President Trump's statement that he would soon make a 'final determination' on a preliminary agreement with Iran to extend the ceasefire and begin nuclear negotiations.
